paragraphs: Judicial Systems sells jury management software to courts. Its product Genesis was developed to give courts a way to manage jury operations, and the company says it simplifies juror communications and stabilizes juror ratios.

Services listed on the solutions page include systems training, jury wheel creation, integration work, and printing and mailing of juror summonses. The page describes API-driven integrations between Genesis and existing case management and court systems. That page says the random selection process was tested for 18 months before approval from the U.S. Fifth Circuit Court of Appeals. It also cites independent validation from the National Center for State Courts.

Homepage copy states that over 180 courts across the country rely on the company to power their court operations. The about page describes four decades of experience and partnerships with 180 courts nationwide. It also describes solutions that streamline processes and improve communication for court administrators and jurors.
